Summary: Phase 1: Ship-blocking defects in existing code
Description: Seven critical defects found in the 1 Aug 2026 audit. All are in code that already exists. One (webhook HMAC fail-open) is a live security hole; one (frontend build) blocks CI. Target: 1-2 days.

Summary: Release reserved wallet funds when an invite expires
Description:
SessionService:140 reserves funds at INVITED, but SessionExpiryJob bulk-UPDATEs INVITED->EXPIRED without ever calling walletService.releaseFunds. Every expired invite permanently strands the session cost in reservedPaise.

Acceptance criteria:
- Replace the bulk UPDATE with a paged fetch-then-release loop (or add a compensating sweep)
- Fix the Javadoc, which currently asserts the opposite of what the code does
- Write a one-off migration/job to release funds already stranded by this bug
- Integration test: expire an invited session, assert reservedPaise returns to zero

Summary: Make webhook HMAC verification fail closed
Description:
WebhookService:296-300 skips signature verification entirely when the configured secret is blank, on a permitAll endpoint. A missing env var silently lets an unauthenticated caller forge payment.captured and mint wallet credit.

Acceptance criteria:
- Reject the request and log an error when the secret is absent
- @PostConstruct assertion that the secret is non-blank outside the local profile
- Test covering blank-secret rejection

Summary: Fix staging JWT and invite key configuration
Description:
application-staging.yml sets no app.security.jwt.private-key-pem / public-key-pem / invite secret, so TokenConfig falls back to generating ephemeral keys on every boot. Every restart invalidates all tokens and all outstanding candidate invite links. Its app.jwt.* keys also bind to nothing (wrong prefix).

Acceptance criteria:
- Source keys from SSM Parameter Store
- Correct the app.jwt.* -> app.security.jwt.* prefix
- TokenConfig fails startup rather than generating ephemeral keys outside the local profile

Summary: Set app.frontend.base-url in the production profile
Description: application-prod.yml never sets app.frontend.base-url, so it falls back to http://localhost:3000 and production candidate invite emails would contain dead links.

There is no CorsConfigurationSource, no .cors() call and no allowed-origins property anywhere in src/main. The SPA cannot call the API cross-origin as shipped.

Acceptance criteria:
- CorsConfigurationSource bound to app.security.cors.allowed-origins
- Applied to both security filter chains
- Per-environment origin lists

CandidatesPage.tsx:276-281 and JobDetailPage.tsx:80 pass status and jobId to candidatesApi.list, which accepts neither. tsc --strict rejects it and both filters are silently dead at runtime.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add status and jobId to the list param type and thread them to the backend
- Backend supports both filters
- npm run build passes

Summary: Validate file uploads (size, MIME, key ownership)
Description:
No size or content-type validation exists on any upload path, and upload-confirm accepts a client-supplied S3 key with no ownership check, allowing cross-tenant object access.

Acceptance criteria:
- Whitelist content types per upload type
- ContentLengthRange conditions on pre-signed PUTs (JD 10MB, resume 5MB, logo 2MB, recording 500MB)
- Validate objectKey matches {companyId}/{entityId}/... prefix
- Verify the S3 object exists before confirming

frontend/package-lock.json is missing, so npm ci fails in both frontend-ci.yml:41 and frontend/Dockerfile:8. No .dockerignore exists at root or in frontend/, so .git and .env ship in the build context.

Summary: Phase 2: Align to spec, remove superseded architecture
Description: Correct wrong config values, migrate the session state machine, and delete the Recall.ai / Google Meet / Transcribe / Polly surface superseded by the April 2026 architecture. Target: 2-3 days.

Summary: Correct session cost from Rs.50 to Rs.100
Description: app.billing.session-cost-paise is 5000 (Rs.50); spec says Rs.100. Touches application.yml:142, .env.example:126, docker-compose.yml:101, BillingPage.tsx (193, 333, 358) and DashboardPage.tsx:131.

Summary: Correct JWT and invite token TTLs
Description: Access token 15min -> 60min; refresh 30d -> 7d; invite token 7d -> 72h (48h on reinvite). The invite email body also hardcodes '7 days'.

Summary: Correct evaluation weights and recommendation bands
Description: EvaluationWorker:216 uses 30/20/30/20; spec requires Technical 40 / Communication 20 / Relevance 25 / Problem-solving 15. Recommendation bands are not enforced at all - add Strong Yes 85-100, Yes 65-84, No 40-64, Strong No 0-39.

Add IN_PROGRESS and EVALUATING to the session status CHECK constraint, add recording_s3_key and consent_accepted_at columns, then write the SessionStateMachine class that SessionStatus's Javadoc already claims exists.

Summary: Per-workflow AI vendor and model configuration
Description:
Replace the single global spring.ai.openai.chat.options.model with per-workflow vendor+model config (question / followup / evaluation). Build a ChatClient bean per workflow, injected by qualifier. Add spring-ai-anthropic alongside spring-ai-openai.

Note: application.yml:73 currently pins gpt-4o, which is no longer listed on OpenAI's pricing page.

Summary: Move AI prompts to StringTemplate files
Description: Prompts are inline Java string concatenation in QuestionGenerationWorker and EvaluationWorker. Spec requires resources/prompts/*.st StringTemplate files so prompts can be iterated without a code change. The directory does not exist.
validateJson() only checks the response parses. Add: array shape check, question count within range, duplicate detection, score bounds, required-field presence.

QuestionGenerationWorker:118 - a response outside 8-12 questions passes the Java validator then trips the DB CHECK at flush. The catch block saves FAILED inside the same doomed transaction, so the marker never persists and the session re-polls forever. Save the failure marker in a REQUIRES_NEW transaction.

Summary: Delete Recall.ai, Google Meet, Transcribe and Polly code
Description:
~15 files superseded by the April 2026 in-browser architecture: RecallTranscriptClient, WebhookService.handleRecall + processRecallBot*, POST /webhooks/recall, WebhookProvider.RECALL_AI, BotServiceException, SetMeetUrlRequest, SessionResponse.googleMeetUrl, both meet-url endpoints, RecallProperties + app.recall.* in 4 profiles, recall_bot_id and google_meet_url columns, and the transcribestreaming + polly SDK dependencies (declared with zero Java usage).

BLOCKED BY Phase 3: WebhookService.handleRecall is currently the ONLY code path that moves a session past INVITED. It must survive until the browser interview room is live, then be removed in the same PR.

shared/audit/AuditSource.java (byte-identical duplicate of audit/domain/AuditSource.java, unused); SessionNote / NoteType / SessionNoteRepository / table V008 (referenced by nothing); frontend/README.md (default Vite template); duplicate tailwind.config.js + .ts; committed vite.config.ts.timestamp-*.mjs; .DS_Store files.

The product itself. WebSocket signalling, candidate room backend (7 endpoints), and the React room using getUserMedia / MediaRecorder / Web Speech API. Target: 2-3 weeks. Largest single piece of work and the most estimation risk.

Add spring-boot-starter-websocket. InterviewWebSocketHandler extends TextWebSocketHandler at /ws/session/{sessionId}, authenticated from the ?token= query param.

Implement all 8 events: session.start, question.next, answer.submit, followup.question, proctoring.event, timer.warning, session.end, session.terminated.

In-memory ConcurrentHashMap session registry - document loudly that this is correct at one instance only.
ScheduledExecutorService per session emitting timer.warning at 10/5/1 minutes and session.terminated at the 60-minute hard cutoff. Must survive task replacement.

Summary: ECS task scale-in protection tied to session lifecycle
Description:
Without this, ECS will terminate a Fargate task holding live interviews during a scale-in event, killing candidates' sessions mid-interview.

Acceptance criteria:
- Call the ECS scale-in protection API when a session enters IN_PROGRESS
- Release protection on COMPLETED / terminated
- ALB sticky sessions enabled
- ALB deregistration delay set to 3600s
- Test scale-in with an active session

Summary: Candidate authentication and session validation endpoints
Description: GET /candidate/session?token= (validate invite token, return session details, do NOT start) and POST /candidate/auth/otp (email OTP -> candidate JWT, 2h TTL, scoped to one session). Reuse the existing OtpService and TokenService. No Google OAuth for candidates in MVP.

Summary: Interview start, question and answer endpoints
Description:
POST /candidate/sessions/{id}/start (consent, 60-min server timer, returns first question); GET /candidate/sessions/{id}/questions/{index}; POST /candidate/sessions/{id}/answers (store, decide follow-up via LLM, return next question or end signal).

New table: session_answers (sessionId, questionIndex, questionText, transcriptText, durationSeconds, isFollowUp, score).
POST /candidate/sessions/{id}/events accepting tab_switch, camera_off, face_detected, session_ended with metadata and timestamp. New table: session_events. Replaces the old /api/webhooks/recall.
POST /candidate/sessions/{id}/complete (recordingS3Key, totalDurationSeconds) -> EVALUATING -> async evaluation -> COMPLETED, settle wallet, send completion email to recruiter.

Summary: Candidate room: preflight and consent screens
Description: Chromium browser gate (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc all qualify), camera/microphone permission preflight with device selection and a live preview, and a consent screen. Put the browser requirement in the invite email too.

Summary: Candidate room: media capture and recording
Description: getUserMedia + MediaRecorder chunked capture at 480p / 600kbps video with Opus audio (~135MB per 30-min interview). Upload the blob to S3 via pre-signed URL on completion.

Summary: Candidate room: speech synthesis and recognition
Description:
SpeechSynthesis reads each question aloud. Web Speech API SpeechRecognition transcribes the candidate's answer live with an interim-results display.

Must include a typed-answer fallback - microphone permission will be denied often enough to matter.

Summary: Candidate room: WebSocket client with reconnect and resume
Description: Connect, handle all 8 server events, exponential-backoff reconnect that resumes mid-interview without losing answered questions. Must survive a Fargate task replacement.

visibilitychange -> tab_switch; video track onmute/onended -> camera_off. Emit over WebSocket.

Note: the browser FaceDetector API is behind Chrome's Experimental Web Platform Features flag and is NOT available by default - multi-face detection needs MediaPipe or face-api.js and is deferred to Phase 2.

All currently missing: hard 60-minute duration cap; 'Could you elaborate a little more?' prompt on answers under 5 words; 60-second silence prompt; 90 seconds of silence marks the question Skipped and advances.

Strip candidate name, email and phone from transcripts before sending to any LLM; pass an opaque candidate_ref and re-attach identity locally when persisting the report. Free, and the strongest data-residency control available given no vendor keeps inference in India.

Build all infrastructure from zero - the terraform/ folder currently contains only two .DS_Store files. ECS Fargate ARM64 autoscaling 2->6, ALB, RDS, WAF, GuardDuty. Target: 1 week, parallelisable with Phase 3.

VPC, 2 public + 2 private subnets across 2 AZs, security groups (Fargate SG accepts inbound only from ALB SG; RDS SG accepts only Fargate SG), free S3 gateway endpoint. No NAT Gateway - Fargate tasks run in public subnets with assignPublicIp and a strict SG, saving ~$32/mo.

Cluster, ARM64 task definition (0.5 vCPU / 1 GB), service with min 2 / max 6 tasks across 2 AZs, target-tracking autoscaling on ALBRequestCountPerTarget with CPU 65% secondary, task + execution IAM roles, scale-in protection permissions, SSM secret injection.
Target group, HTTPS listener with ACM certificate, HTTP->HTTPS redirect, WebSocket support, sticky sessions, 3600s deregistration delay, WAF association, health check on /actuator/health.

PostgreSQL 16, db.t4g.micro Single-AZ, 20GB gp3 with storage autoscaling enabled, private subnet group, 7-day automated backups, encryption at rest.

Also cap HikariCP at 8 connections per task - 6 tasks x 20 would exceed t4g.micro's ~85 connection limit precisely at peak load.
Three S3 buckets (recordings with 7-day expiry, assets, frontend) with Block Public Access and SSE-S3; CloudFront + ACM + Route 53 for the SPA and API domains.
ECR repository with a lifecycle policy keeping 10 images and basic scanning enabled; SSM Parameter Store SecureString parameters; SES domain identity with DKIM, SPF and DMARC.
AWS WAF web ACL on the ALB with managed Core and Known-Bad-Inputs rule sets (~$9/mo); GuardDuty enabled (~$8/mo); CloudTrail first trail.
CloudWatch alarms (5xx rate, ECS CPU/memory, RDS connections, evaluation-worker failures, ALB unhealthy hosts), SNS topic with email subscription, log groups with 7-day retention.

Summary: Terraform: remote state, environments and gitignore
Description: S3 backend with a DynamoDB lock table; envs/staging and envs/production workspaces. Add .terraform/, *.tfstate*, *.tfvars to .gitignore - all currently missing.

GitHub Actions -> OIDC assume role (no static AWS keys) -> build ARM64 image -> push to ECR -> aws ecs update-service --force-new-deployment -> wait-for-stable -> automatic rollback on failed health checks. Plus S3 sync + CloudFront invalidation for the frontend.

Replaces the current pipeline, which pushes to GHCR and has no deployment step at all.
Complete the revenue path: payment verification, GST invoicing (a legal requirement for Indian B2B), and balance notifications. Target: 3-4 days.
The top-up flow currently depends entirely on the Razorpay webhook, so any webhook delay leaves the user looking at a stale balance. Add signature verification and idempotent wallet credit.

There are zero occurrences of 'gst' in the backend. Add gst_number to companies, gross/tax/net columns on wallet_transactions, 18% GST calculation, and GET /billing/transactions/{txnId}/invoice. Legal requirement for Indian B2B, not a nice-to-have.

Summary: Low-balance alerts and payment failure handling
Description: Low-balance email at <= Rs.300 and a persistent dashboard banner below Rs.300; handle the payment.failed webhook; add a session-completion email to the recruiter. EmailService currently has exactly two templates (OTP and candidate invite).

Summary: Phase 6: Dashboard, storage, scheduling and remaining CRUD
Description: Modules with no implementation at all, plus the missing behaviour inside endpoints that do exist. Target: 1-2 weeks.
GET /dashboard/stats, /recent-sessions, /score-distribution. DashboardPage currently fabricates stats client-side from totalElements on four list queries.

GET /storage/upload-url, GET /candidate/storage/upload-url, POST /storage/upload-confirm. Start actually writing to the storage_objects table (V013), which exists and has never held a row. Add RECORDING and LOGO object types.
Five endpoints (create/list/delete slots, candidate slot list, book slot), employer slot-management UI, candidate slot picker, and @Version optimistic-lock double-booking protection.

Generate 12-20 questions on JD upload, GET /jobs/{jobId}/questions, recruiter preview UI. Generation is currently per-session, not per-job.

Note: the V024 DB CHECK enforces 8-12 questions and would REJECT the spec's 12-20 range - fix the constraint in the same migration.

Summary: Candidate update and delete with guards
Description: PUT /candidates/{id} (only before invite sent) and DELETE /candidates/{id} (only if no completed session). Add the missing phone field to DTO, entity and table.

Summary: List filters for jobs and candidates
Description: status and search on GET /jobs (the repository method exists but is unused; the UI filters client-side over the current page only); status on the candidate list.

Summary: Company profile completion and logo upload
Description: POST /company/logo (no MultipartFile handling exists anywhere in the backend) plus the missing logoUrl, industry, size and gstNumber fields in the DTO, entity and companies table.

Summary: Session reinvite, recording playback and transcript download
Description: POST /sessions/{id}/reinvite (missing entirely), GET /sessions/{id}/recording (15-min pre-signed URL), GET /sessions/{id}/transcript. The transcript is currently fetched in memory at evaluation time and discarded - EvaluationReport.transcriptS3Key is a dead column.

Per-dimension score breakdown with the specific quoted answer driving each score (a bare number gets ignored by recruiters), employer internal notes, proctoring-event display, print-to-PDF stylesheet, score-distribution chart.

Summary: Google OAuth and SES bounce webhook
Description:
GET /auth/google + /auth/google/callback (no oauth2-client dependency exists), GET /auth/me, POST /webhooks/ses-bounce with SNS subscription confirmation and a suppression list.

Lowest priority in this epic - email OTP already works, and bounce handling matters only at volume.
Company list, interview counts, cost tracking, manual wallet credit with a mandatory reason. No route, page, endpoint or API module exists.
9 of 13 backend modules have zero tests, including session lifecycle and the AI pipeline. The frontend has none at all. Target: 1 week, then ongoing.
Add Testcontainers and maven-failsafe. CI already starts a Postgres service container that nothing uses. Cover the session lifecycle end-to-end first - it is the highest-value untested path.

Summary: Unit tests for wallet, AI and session modules
Description: Wallet ledger invariants (reserve/settle/release, concurrent top-up), question-generation validation, evaluation scoring and weighting, session state machine transitions.

Summary: Frontend test setup and initial tests
Description: jsdom, @vitest/ui and @vitest/coverage-v8 are not installed, so all three test scripts fail today. Install them, write MSW handlers, and wire npm test and eslint into CI.
Add JaCoCo with a floor starting at 40% and ratcheting upward, rather than picking a number nobody hits.

Score every interview with both GPT-5.4-mini and Claude Haiku 4.5, serve one to the recruiter, log both. Combine with the 'did you hire this candidate?' feedback to compute a real Pearson r per vendor over the first ~50 interviews.

Cost: ~Rs.900 for the whole experiment. Decides the evaluation vendor with data instead of a guess.
Structured logging, alarms, and the security items that are not ship-blockers. Target: 3-4 days.

application-prod.yml:71-72 claims structured JSON output, but there is no logback config file at all and the pattern references an MDC traceId that nothing populates. Add a logback JSON encoder, populate the MDC, ship to CloudWatch with 7-day retention.

Summary: Move refresh token to an HTTP-only cookie
Description: Currently stored in localStorage and passed in the JSON body, so any XSS becomes account takeover. Move to an HTTP-only, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookie; set withCredentials: true on the client.

Summary: Rate limiting and account lockout per spec
Description:
Current implementation is a 20-burst / 10-per-minute per-IP bucket over all /api/v1/**. Spec requires 5 failed logins per IP per minute with a 15-minute lockout (needs failed_attempts and locked_until columns, which do not exist) and a 3-per-15-minute OTP resend cap.

Also bound the RateLimitFilter bucket map - it grows without eviction today.

Summary: Disable Swagger UI outside local and staging
Description: SecurityConfig:157-158 permits /v3/api-docs/** and /swagger-ui/** in all profiles, exposing the full API surface in production. OpenApiConfig acknowledges this and recommends a conditional bean.

Server-level add_header directives are silently dropped by both location blocks that set their own, nullifying X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy. No CSP, no HSTS, no client_max_body_size.

Consider removing nginx entirely - the SPA is served from CloudFront and the ALB fronts the API, so the container may not be needed in production.

Summary: Handle ConstraintViolationException in the global handler
Description: GlobalExceptionHandler has no ConstraintViolationException handler, so @Validated @RequestParam failures return 500 instead of 400.
SES production access, load testing, compliance and pilot launch. Target: 1 week.
Move SES out of sandbox and configure DKIM, SPF and DMARC. START THIS EARLY - it is the longest external dependency in the plan and approval takes days.

Gatling test against the real Fargate configuration, per the PRD's 50-concurrent-session NFR. Validates that 0.5 vCPU / 1 GB tasks and the autoscaling policy hold, and that scale-in protection works under load.

The PRD states 'all data stored and processed in AWS ap-south-1'. This is false the moment any external LLM is called - AWS's own documentation confirms Claude on Bedrock in India uses global cross-region inference routing to AWS commercial regions worldwide, and OpenAI has no India region.

Acceptance criteria:
- Rewrite the claim in the privacy policy and customer contract to something defensible
- Obtain zero-retention / no-training terms in writing from the chosen AI vendor
- Confirm PII redaction (Phase 3) is live

Summary: Advisory-score disclaimer and candidate data deletion
Description: State explicitly in the product and the MSA that the score is advisory, that InterviewEngine performs no automated rejection, and that a human makes every decision. Add the candidate data-deletion endpoint the PRD commits to but does not implement. Present the privacy policy at candidate login.
Security review against the OWASP Top 10 checklist per the PRD's Sprint 6 plan. Add OWASP dependency-check to CI.
Live validation with three pilot customers before general availability.
